in_marathi.name: Vishalaksha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vishalaksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from two Sanskrit words, 'vishala' meaning large or wide and 'aksha' meaning eyes.
